animations.notes: Bubble has no built-in animation engine. Animations are plugin-based (AOS, GSAP via Toolbox). Check per-site.

quirks.description: Bubble has two rendering engines: legacy (absolute positioning with bubble-r-line/bubble-r-box) and new (flexbox with bubble-r-container/flex/column/row). Both can coexist.
quirks.workaround: Check for .bubble-r-container.flex (new) vs .bubble-r-line (legacy). Section selector handles both.

quirks.description: Bubble applies virtually ALL styling as inline style attributes. Classes are structural (bubble-element, Group, Text) not visual.
quirks.workaround: Extract computed styles. Inline styles ARE the source of truth. No class-to-Tailwind mapping possible.

quirks.description: Each element has a short alphanumeric hash class (cmgwv, cmbaIaX) as unique identifier. Not semantic, changes across deployments.
quirks.workaround: Use element type class (Group, Text, Image, Button, Shape) for labeling, not hash ID.

quirks.description: Content is inside div.main-page.bubble-element.Page, not direct body children. Body also has floating groups, popups, GroupFocus overlays, slideable menus.
quirks.workaround: Use .main-page > * as primary selector. Include body > .floating-group for fixed nav.

quirks.description: Navigation bars are div.floating-group siblings of .main-page, not children. Bubble's equivalent of fixed/sticky headers.
quirks.workaround: Section discovery includes body > .floating-group to capture nav sections.

quirks.description: Bubble sets theme colors/fonts as CSS custom properties on <html>: --font_default, --color_primary_default, --color_text_default, etc. (each with _rgb variant).
quirks.workaround: Extract CSS custom properties and map to Tailwind theme configuration.

quirks.description: div.bubble-element.Shape elements are decorative (backgrounds, dividers, colored boxes). Empty divs with background-color/border-radius in inline styles.
quirks.workaround: Map Shape elements to decorative <div> with Tailwind classes from computed styles.

quirks.description: Images served via Cloudflare Image Resizing at cdn-cgi/image/w={w},h={h},f=auto,dpr={dpr},fit={fit}/. Asset ID format: f{timestamp}x{id}.
quirks.workaround: Strip cdn-cgi/image/ path to get raw image URL. Use Cloudflare params for responsive sizes.

localSite.sectionSelector: body > header, body > nav, main > *, body > footer
